title: Argentina's bid to stop Falklands oil drilling rejected
description: A joint venture between UK-Israeli companies is set to start exploring for oil and gas, but Argentina sought to block it as part of its claim to sovereignty.

title: Pensions and benefits services still down after 'cyber incident'
description: The UK's former chief technology officer says the Department for Work and Pensions may have been hit by hackers, but the government has not confirmed that.

title: Man arrested on suspicion of murdering girl, 16
description: The girl was found at a property in east London on Friday afternoon after fears about her welfare.

title: Two staff killed in Israeli strike on Gaza medical clinic, MSF says
description: The Israeli military says it targeted "Hamas terrorists" in the strike which has been condemned by the World Health Organization.

title: Woman, 21, dies in Staffordshire crash following police pursuit
description: Two forces are being investigated after Friday's late night crash on Rugeley Road in Hednesford.

title: OpenAI counter-sues Apple over alleged theft of trade secrets
description: The ChatGPT-maker alleges that tech giant Apple stole trade secrets through a former employee.

title: Catherine's emotional cancer documentary strips away the stiff upper lip
description: The Princess of Wales has made a documentary, Heal, describing her cancer experience in her own words.

title: 'I don't know what I'd do without it': Is this the end for Poundland?
description: With baskets loaded full of bargains, shoppers at the much-loved chain tell the BBC the high street doesn't need more empty shops.

title: A clinic is offering to reassess ADHD and autism diagnoses - and hundreds of people are interested
description: While many people find a diagnosis for ADHD or autism affirming, a government-funded clinic in Sweden is re-assessing people who feel it does not reflect them.
